SELECT COALESCE(SUM(), 0) FROM tbl_transaction t WHERE
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.tr_date, '%Y-%m') AS `year_month`, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS amount FROM tbl_transaction t WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.tr_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY `year_month`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.tr_date, '%Y-%m') AS `year_month`, t.category_id, COALESCE(c.category_name, '미분류') AS category_name, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS amount FROM tbl_transaction t LEFT JOIN tbl_category c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.tr_date, '%Y-%m'), t.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY `year_month`, amount DESC, t.category_id
